note: SHA-256 over the canonical JSON (sorted keys, compact separators) of the frozen decoder: r_lo, calibrated r_hi, chain.py hash, the completed E(r) table at rates 0/25/50/75/100/125/155 Hz, E_max, theta_off and the two extension signs. theta_ext is build-derived per episode (theta_ext_from_params on the compiled parameters) and is recorded per run in the run manifests; it is not a decoder constant.
